stories.title: Nyt, Mosca prepara l'offensiva, 'mille missili contro le centrali ucraine'

en.title: NYT, Moscow prepares offensive, 'thousand missiles against Ukrainian power plants'
en.summary: According to a US newspaper report, Russia is preparing a major military offensive targeting Ukrainian energy infrastructure, raising humanitarian concerns. Ukrainian President Zelensky characterizes Putin as operating without restraint and seeking to isolate Kyiv.

stories.title: Trump distende i toni con l'Europa sul diesel ed elogia Meloni

en.title: Trump softens tone with Europe on diesel and praises Meloni
en.summary: The US President indicates no restrictions on fuel exports to Europe and reassures allies following a strategic reserves agreement. A political tour is underway.

stories.title: Trump, dietrofront su Meloni:“Lei mi è sempre piaciuta”

en.title: Trump reverses course on Meloni: "I've always liked her"
en.summary: Trump has resolved recent tensions with Italian Prime Minister Meloni, stating he has always held her in positive regard. Previous months saw friction between the American president and the Italian premier.

stories.title: Francia-Italia, le pagelle: Olise cambia passo nella ripresa, Donnarumma monumentale

en.title: France-Italy, player ratings: Olise changes pace in second half, Donnarumma monumental
en.summary: Performance evaluations from the match held in Saint-Denis assessed individual players on both teams.

stories.title: Trump, 'il mio rapporto con Meloni è molto buono, mi è sempre piaciuta'

en.title: Trump: 'My relationship with Meloni is very good, I've always liked her'
en.summary: Trump stated in response to journalists that his relationship with Italian Prime Minister Meloni is very good and that he has always liked her.

stories.title: Trump a La Stampa: “Il mio rapporto con Meloni è molto buono, mi è sempre piaciuta”

en.title: Trump to La Stampa: "My relationship with Meloni is very good, I've always liked her"
en.summary: Following months of diplomatic tension and friction, Trump told La Stampa that he likes Meloni and has always liked her, as the two countries seek to restore relations.

stories.title: Giorgetti, deficit sotto il 3% nel 2026, sale al 3,4% nel 2027

en.title: Giorgetti, deficit below 3% in 2026, rises to 3.4% in 2027
en.summary: Italy's deficit is projected below 3% for 2026 before increasing to 3.4% in 2027, with debt reaching 138.1% and 138.6% respectively in those years.

stories.title: Manovra, Giorgetti: "Deficit previsto sotto il 3% nel 2026, poi sale al 3,4 nel 2027"

en.title: Budget measure, Giorgetti: "Deficit forecast below 3% in 2026, then rises to 3.4 in 2027"
en.summary: Italy's Economy Minister presented the approved budget with deficit projections of under 3% for 2026 and 3.4% for 2027, while GDP growth estimates were updated to 1% for 2026.

stories.title: Schlein avverte Conte: "Uno non vale uno"

en.title: Schlein warns Conte: "One is not equal to one"
en.summary: Italy's Democratic Party secretary stated her party earned its position as the leading opposition force and criticized the government for failing on wages and inflation, while the Prime Minister disputed these claims.

stories.title: Deficit below 3% in 2026, rising to 3.5% in 2027 says Giorgetti

en.title: Deficit below 3% in 2026, rising to 3.5% in 2027 says Giorgetti
en.summary: Italy's economy minister projects the deficit will fall below 3% in 2026 before rising to 3.5% in 2027, suggesting a possible exit from the excessive-deficit procedure.

stories.title: Schlein a Meloni: "Avete fallito, andate a casa". E a Conte: "Pd primo partito, uno non vale uno"

en.title: Schlein to Meloni: "You have failed, go home". And to Conte: "PD is the leading party, one does not equal one"
en.summary: Italy's Democratic Party secretary challenged coalition partners over program negotiations, asserting her party's superior voting strength, while attacking the current government's record as the country faces crucial months ahead.

stories.title: Schlein avverte Conte: “Al tavolo del programma uno non vale uno”. E attacca Meloni: “Avete fallito”

en.title: Schlein warns Conte: "At the program table one does not equal one". And attacks Meloni: "You have failed"
en.summary: The Democratic Party secretary confronted her allies over power-sharing in negotiations, emphasizing her party's double voting advantage, while calling for immediate government change through elections.

en.title: Branded entertainment, the big show of brands is worth 853 million
en.summary: The branded entertainment sector is accelerating in 2026, driven by new formats and integrated strategies according to Obe data.

en.summary: D-Orbit, a leader in space logistics and orbital transport, launched a mission with a total mass approaching 1.5 tonnes, setting a new record.

en.title: Confindustria Lombardy in the field for generational transition
en.summary: Long-established companies like Cartiera Mantovana and Fabbrica d'Armi Beretta are successfully managing generational transitions despite their centuries-old histories.

stories.title: Neet dimezzati in dieci anni, ma sono ancora 1,2 milioni: il costo sociale è di 24 miliardi

en.title: Neets halved in ten years, but still 1.2 million: the social cost is 24 billion
en.summary: Young people aged 15-29 who neither study nor work have declined significantly, yet Italy remains among countries with highest rates, with a social cost of 24 billion euros.

stories.title: Fondi europei, il Nord “in autogestione”: sei regioni preparano il piano prima del Governo

en.title: European funds, the North 'self-managing': six regions prepare the plan before the Government
en.summary: Six northern Italian regions are developing their own preliminary plan for European funding allocation while awaiting Rome's decision on regional roles in the next European programming period.
